in_marathi.name: Anvita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anvita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anvita is a Sanskrit name meaning 'graceful, fearless'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anu' meaning 'near' and 'vit' meaning 'fear'. Anvita is a name that is often given to girls in Hindu communities as it embodies the qualities of being graceful and fearless.
